title: Huizenga Loses House Seat Despite $1 Million From Crypto PAC Fairshake
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Huizenga Loses House Seat Despite $1 Million From Crypto PAC Fairshake Rep. Bill Huizenga, vice chair of the House Financial Services Committee, lost despite $1 million from Fairshake. This post Huizenga Loses House Seat Despite $1 Million From Crypto PAC Fairshake first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
